description: 一次无凭据官方目录收件，实际URL/原字节/请求结果保留，不重试。
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from urllib.parse import urljoin
ROOT=Path.cwd();OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_dr007_official_history_catalog_probe_v1'
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
p=json.loads((OUT/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert not (OUT/'request_ledger.json').exists(),'原请求已执行，不重新请求。'
for r in p['parents']:assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/r['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r['sha256']
url=p['fixed_catalog_url'];rec={'request_id':1,'requested_at':now(),'method':'GET','url':url,'credential_used':False,'retry':0,'purpose':'核对官方成交概览目录，未请求实际历史值'}
raw=b''
try:
 with requests.get(url,headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0','Accept':'text/html,application/xhtml+xml'},timeout=(10,25),stream=True) as response:
  rec.update(http_status=response.status_code,final_url=response.url,content_type=response.headers.get('Content-Type'),response_date_header=response.headers.get('Date'))
  for chunk in response.iter_content(65536):
   raw+=chunk
   if len(raw)>4*1024*1024:raise RuntimeError('公开对象预算超过4MiB，停止。')
 rec['received_at']=now();rec['bytes']=len(raw);rec['sha256']=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
 (OUT/'raw_01_官方成交概览.html').write_bytes(raw)
 rec['raw_path']=(OUT/'raw_01_官方成交概览.html').relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
 if rec['http_status']!=200:rec['status']='FAILED_HTTP_NO_RETRY'
 else:rec['status']='RECEIVED_PUBLIC_CATALOG'
except Exception as e:
 rec.update(received_at=now(),bytes=len(raw),status='FAILED_REQUEST_NO_RETRY',exception_class=type(e).__name__,public_error=str(e))
(OUT/'request_ledger.json').write_text(json.dumps([rec],ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(rec,ensure_ascii=False))
if rec['status']=='RECEIVED_PUBLIC_CATALOG':
 soup=BeautifulSoup(raw.decode('utf-8',errors='replace'),'html.parser')
 found=[]
 for tag in soup.find_all(True):
  attrs={k:v for k,v in tag.attrs.items() if any(x in k.lower() for x in ['url','src','href'])}
  text=tag.get_text(' ',strip=True)
  if attrs and (tag.name=='script' or any(x in text[:100] for x in ['历史','回购','成交','查询','货币'])):
   found.append({'tag':tag.name,'attributes':attrs,'text':text[:150]})
 for i,line in enumerate(raw.decode('utf-8',errors='replace').splitlines()):
  if any(x in line for x in ['组件','component','san-load','data-url','san-tab','url:','mtmon','hstry','history','DR007','回购','成交量']):
   found.append({'line':i+1,'text':line[:800]})
 (OUT/'目录组件与原行定位.json').write_text(json.dumps(found,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
 print(json.dumps(found,ensure_ascii=False)[:12500])
